'''CS-321''' was a [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droid]] that was the owned by [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].
It was destroyed during a [[Rescue of Adi Gallia/Legends|battle]] between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] forces.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Soon it will be us.|CS-321 to C-3PO about fighting K0-5D in a gladiatorial arena|<ref name="Nomad Droids">{{TCW|Nomad Droids}}</ref>}}
CS-321 was at some point procured by some Weequay pirates. It was present on the Weequay pirate ship, [[Marauder (Weequay pirate ship)/Legends|''Marauder'']] when two droids, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were captured on [[Balnab/Legends|Balnab]] by the pirates. He was watching a gladiatorial fight between droids which was meant for the Weequay's entertainment. CS-321 was to fight in the arena soon. [[ASP-series labor droid/Legends|One droid]], [[K0-5D/Legends|K0-5D]] kept blasting away at its competition in the arena which instilled fear inside C-3PO. CS-321 informed him that they were next which further scared C-3PO. However, when C-3PO and R2 were about to take on K0-5D, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], who was passing by, attacked the ''Marauder'' for target practice. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] blew a hole in the ship which sucked C-3PO, R2, K0-5D, CS-321, several other droids, and Weequays into space. CS-321 along with some other droids were captured by Grievous's [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and taken to [[Grievous's Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Patitite Pattuna)/Legends|his ship]] where they would be incinerated.

==Behind the scenes==
CS-321 was voiced by [[Kevin Michael Richardson]].
